I have a question regarding taxi cabs in Chicago. Is it allowable to tranport drunk passengers? Let me explain you the situation here: During morning shifts(5Am to 5PM) the passengers are mostly those going to office, airport or shopping malls. But during evening shifts, customers are mostly going to Bars/Pubs/strip clubs. There are certain streets which have bars one after the other. Going on those streets means you are going near bars. Also cabbies line up outside famous bars/pubs. If you want to avoid these customers you have to take small streets where you are almost certain of not getting any customers. Then to pick up customers you have to go to office areas which will be very far. After 11PM there is hardly anyone else on the streets other than drunk revelers. Another issue you can consider is that if anyone is trying to flag you down, you cannot refuse them. But that is just a rule and can be conveniently broken. In short avoiding bar areas is feasible but you make 1/3rd of what other people make. 2137 views Q. purchasing of plot 2194 views Q. answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 40836 Country: India Title: Working on Cruise Ships & Missing Jumuah is haram or halal Question: My question is that whether working/job on Cruise Ships is allowed or not? (1) Cruise ships have bars and casinos, so if someone works as part of management of the ship not specifically of the bars or casinos, so can working be allowed and income is halal? (2) Chances are that Jumuah prayers will be missed for several weeks or even months, so in this case working is allowed or not? Answer ID: 40836 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1230/809/H=1433) (1) If you do your job keeping yourself away from wine and gambling then in the above mentioned case it is allowable. In this case your income shall not be termed as haram rather it shall be halal. (2) If you miss Jumuah because your ship is in such a place where Jumuah is not valid then you will not deserve the warning of missing Jumuah. Yes, if your ship has cast anchor at seaport which is situated at the city or big town and you have the facility to offer Jumuah salah and yet you miss Jumuah salah then you shall deserve the warning. Though in this case your income and salary shall not be termed as haram but you shall be sinful for missing Jumuah salah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
